title: Exploring the Future: AI Agents Leading the AI Revolution
summary: LLM maturity (GPT-4 as controller) + viral Agent projects (Stanford Smallville, CAMEL, BabyAGI, AutoGPT; 100+ on Product Hunt) lifted Agents from copywriting endpoints to general problem frameworks. AutoGPT ~150k GitHub stars by end-Aug—fastest-growing open-source star history.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight · September 1, 2023 · Company map + definitions + autonomous vs generative Agents — full rewrite

LLM maturity (GPT-4 as controller) + viral Agent projects (Stanford Smallville, CAMEL, BabyAGI, AutoGPT; 100+ on Product Hunt) lifted Agents from copywriting endpoints to general problem frameworks. AutoGPT ~150k GitHub stars by end-Aug—fastest-growing open-source star history. End-to-end demos: AutoCorp brand ads/product design; GPTeam multi-Agent collab; GPT Researcher online synthesis.

Westworld NPCs → Stanford’s April 25-Agent Smallville (Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior): daily routines, opinions, noticing peers, memory→planning; emergent Valentine’s party invites from one seed goal.

Representative companies

  • Lanma Tech (澜码) (2023) — everyone designs their own Agents; LLM automation platform; data-flywheel multimodal foundation from PC/phone/meeting skills.
  • Waveform Intelligence (波形) — entertainment-chain AI interactive content; interactive long-text gen beyond GPT APIs; CEO Jiang Yuchen (ZJU Chu Kochen → ETH AI PhD under Ryan Cotterell; MSRA LLM); COO Yu Teng (ex-Zhangmen/ZME); RecurrentGPT paper; vertical interactive models.
  • CAMEL — open community for autonomous/communicative Agents; agents/tasks/prompts/models/datasets/sims; CAMEL-AI.org seeks human–AI coexistence insights (coop/compete, new econ/law/edu systems, science/engineering accel).
  • AutoAgents.ai (未来式智能) — alumni DAMO/Tencent/ByteDance/AWS/Google; goal→plan/decompose→connect data/apps; CS, sales CRM, recruiting, BI.
  • Yantu Intelligence — NLP + KG for finance/insurance/healthcare/e-comm/defense upgrades.
  • Robosell — e-comm general Agents for continuous reason/market/monetize; Duix/Shopify execs + multimodal/RL professor; 67% founders overseas experience; 20+ yrs AI / 10+ e-comm.
  • Cortex (Kinesys AI) — 7 FT; Gen-Z CEO Nemo Yang (Georgia Tech BS/MS in 2 yrs; ByteDance Feishu/Microsoft); private-data AI Co-pilots; privacy-minded efficient LLMs.
  • Mindverse (心识宇宙) — virtual-human brains with thought/consciousness/personality; MindOS create/share AI personas, automate tasks, CS/sales assistants; Future Sci-Tech City talent program; Tsinghua/HKU/UIUC + FB/Alibaba/ByteDance/MSR alumni.
  • Shudian Tech (Mar 2022) — enterprise data-virtualization engine atop existing warehouses; diagnose/optimize/unify data for seamless LLM data services.
  • Dify — easy LLMOps; visual prompt orchestration; models OpenAI/Anthropic/HF/ChatGLM/ERNIE; embeddings from PDF/txt/Notion/web/API; BaaS APIs; plugins (browse/Google/Wikipedia); workspace; log annotation. Core from Tencent Cloud DevOps (6+ yrs).

What is an AI Agent — four rules

  1. Perceive the environment
  2. Use observations to decide
  3. Decisions lead to actions
  4. Actions must be rational (maximize performance / best positive outcome)

Unlike ChatGPT’s answer generation, Agents are assistants that set goals, create/prioritize tasks, iterate to completion—optionally via APIs (browse, apps, files, payments) with less human intervention.

Five classical types: simple reflex · model-based · goal-based · utility-based · learning Agents.

Two development directions

Autonomous Agents (Auto-GPT-class) — NL goal → automated task execution; clear tool serving humans. Generative Agents (Smallville-class) — persona, autonomous decisions, long memory; digital-native social relations beyond tools.

Value & outlook: Agents as engines for virtual worlds and enterprise automation; open questions on coordination, safety, and commercialization paths remain live.

25 CN images; attach on ingest.

— END —
